source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of list creation (PDF 91).

blocks.text: Python mein list square brackets '[ ]' se banti hai, aur har item (cheez) ke baad comma lagta hai. Neeche list banane aur dikhane ka code hai:

# Create a list of items
items = ["Decorations", "Snacks", "cold drinks", "Plates", "Balloon"]
# Print the list
print(items)
blocks.caption: Sahi code (seedhe quotes ke saath)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"# Create a list of items": # se shuru hone wali line comment (sirf insaan ke parhne ke liye note) hai; Python ise chalata nahi.
"items = [...]": items naam ki list banti hai jis mein 5 strings (text) hain. Square brackets [ ] list banate hain aur har item ke beech comma lagta hai.
List mein items usi order (tarteeb) mein rehte hain jis mein likhe gaye: pehla "Decorations" (index 0), aakhri "Balloon" (index 4).
"print(items)": poori list ek hi line mein screen par dikhata hai. Python list dikhate waqt strings ko single quotes ' ' mein dikhata hai.
Output: ['Decorations', 'Snacks', 'cold drinks', 'Plates', 'Balloon'] — wohi 5 items, wohi order.
Khud try karein: "Balloon" ke baad , "Cups" jor kar Run karein: ab list mein 6 items aayenge aur aakhir mein 'Cups' dikhega.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke code mein “cold drinks" aur ”Balloon” par tirchhe (curly) quotes “ ” chhape hain. Python sirf seedhe quotes " ya ' maanta hai, is liye chhapa hua code chalane par SyntaxError aata hai. Upar wala code seedhe quotes ke saath hai aur theek chalta hai.

items: items list ka naam hai (chhota i). Python small aur capital letters mein farq karta hai, is liye items aur Items do alag naam hain.
List ke andar paanch items hain: "Decorations", "Snacks", "cold drinks", "Plates" aur "Balloon".
Har text item quotes mein band hai aur items ke beech comma hai.
print() function list ko screen par dikhata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke list ka naam “Items” hai, aur items “Cold drinks” aur “Balloons” hain. Magar code mein naam items (chhota i) hai aur items "cold drinks" aur "Balloon" hain. Code wala naam hi sahi hai, kyunke Python mein Items aur items alag naam hain.
Aap list mein items jor (add) bhi sakte hain aur nikal (remove) bhi sakte hain. Lists ek hi variable mein kai values rakhne aur unhein aasani se sambhalne ke liye bohat kaam ki hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Linked list bhi list ki ek qisam hai jo nodes se banti hai. Har node mein ek value hoti hai aur agle node ka reference (pata) hota hai.

blocks.prompt: items list mein kitne items hain, aur items[0] kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Paanch items hain; items[0] "Decorations" hai, kyunke index 0 se shuru hota hai.

items: List [ ] aur commas se banti hai; print() use dikhata hai.
Code mein sirf seedhe quotes " ya ' chalte hain.
